$comment: Declares whether this module generates its human-in-the-loop photo review sheet with the shared tool from digital-3d-shared-contracts (tools/photo-survey/review_sheet.py) or with a local fork. Read by scripts/check_photo_tools_sync.mjs.
reason: Blocked on the raw-record shape, not the sheet. This module's data/photos/photos.raw.json is a bare list of records keyed licence_id / lat / lon / title, produced by scripts/ingest_photos.py. The shared tool reads {"observations": [...]} with observation_id / license / position / notes, as written by tools/photo-survey/harvest.py. Forcing the two together would put a field-mapping layer inside the shared tool, which only moves the fork rather than removing it. The category vocabulary IS already migrated: data/photos/photo-campaign.json carries all eleven categories in the shared config shape.
decisions_note: The 537 human decisions in data/photos/review-decisions.json are already in the shared format ("use:cat,cat" / "skip") and reload unchanged, so no review work is lost when this migrates.
